result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_agg_degree_out()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get aggregate value from outdegree of nodes. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L13962-L14057){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_agg_degree_out(agg, conditions=None) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Computes a single aggregate statistic from the outdegree values of all nodes in a directed graph. Useful for summarizing the outdegree distribution or analyzing filtered node subsets. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [agg]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Aggregation function to apply. Must be one of: - `"sum"`: sum of all outdegrees - `"min"`: minimum outdegree - `"max"`: maximum outdegree - `"mean"`: mean outdegree - `"median"`: median outdegree [conditions]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[Callable]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Filter function that takes a node object and returns `True` to include the node in the aggregation. If `None`, all nodes are included. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The computed aggregate outdegree value. Returns `0.0` if no nodes match the conditions. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If the graph is undirected or if `agg=` is not a valid aggregation function. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#a32ab9e3 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec # Create directed graph graph = ec.Graph(directed=True) graph.add_gnm_graph(20, 35, seed=23) # Mean outdegree across all nodes mean_out = graph.get_agg_degree_out('mean') # Returns 1.75 mean_out ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 1.75 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#c7aeebd6 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Median outdegree median_out = graph.get_agg_degree_out('median') # Returns 1.0 median_out # Filtered aggregation: max outdegree of nodes with attributes # First set an attribute on some nodes node_list = list(graph.get_node_ids(limit=5)) graph.set_node_attrs(node_attr='type', values='special', nodes=node_list) max_out = graph.get_agg_degree_out( 'max', conditions=lambda n: n.attributes and 'type' in n.attributes ) ``` :::
